_comment: Permission settings for the UNATTENDED autonomous build loop only.
Not used by interactive sessions.
THE PRIMARY CONTROL IS NOT THIS FILE. It is the git worktree each
dispatched agent works in, which confines its writes to a directory
outside this checkout, plus the allow-list in --allowedTools. Everything
below is defence in depth.
That ordering was learned the hard way by scripts/devlog-cron.sh: its
first version relied on a deny list plus acceptEdits and unscoped
'Write,Edit' in --allowedTools. A test write to $HOME SUCCEEDED, because
the deny list enumerated repo paths and the escape was outside the repo
entirely. A deny-list cannot contain a tool granted for every path.
SYNTAX WARNING, verified empirically 2026-08-25: a Write(path) DENY rule
is SILENTLY IGNORED by file permission checks. Only Edit(path) rules
apply, and they cover every file-editing tool including Write. A deny
list written with Write(...) looks like a control and is not one.
Do NOT add a catch-all like Edit(./*) -- also tested: it matches the
project directory itself and denies everything, which would silently
break every cycle rather than failing loudly.
THE FIRST GROUP IS THE IMPORTANT ONE: the loop may not edit its own
guardrails. A loop that can widen its own permissions has none. Verify
with `orchestration/loop.sh --probe` before arming, and again after any
change to this file.
